summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) broke payment calls: Decimal not JSON serializable, so orders were processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the payments client before redeploying the HTTP library upgrade
Add alerting on payment failures, which were logged only at DEBUG

events.text:
version: v1.6
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) broke payment calls: Decimal not JSON serializable, so orders were processed without payment.

args.impact: Initially 11 of 28 orders processed without payment (money_impact unpaid total_sar 5262.91). reprocess_orders paid 27 orders (money_recovered total_sar 13079.64); all invariants are now green.

args.summary: The v1.6 deploy broke payment calls with a Decimal JSON serialization error. The worker kept marking orders processed without recording payments. I rolled back the deploy and reprocessed all unpaid orders, and the invariants are green again.
